stem:
Kabir heats milk for chai. He chooses among aluminium, wood, and shiny plastic for a pan to heat the milk and for a handle on a hot aluminium pan.

Answer both parts.

options.text: An aluminium pan is suitable for heating milk because aluminium conducts heat well.
An aluminium handle is safer than a wooden handle on the hot aluminium pan.
A wooden handle becomes a good heat conductor when fixed to the aluminium pan.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Metals such as aluminium transfer heat well, so an aluminium pan heats milk usefully, while wood stays a poor conductor and is safer for a handle.

teacher.key_rationale: Aluminium conducts heat well, so it suits a heating pan. A metal handle is less safe than wood, and wood does not become a good conductor by attachment.
